title: Enrollment at Closing and Coverage Period End Dates — Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
**Enrollment.** At closing the original buyer is enrolled in the Calloway Limited Home Warranty under the HomeCare program whose eligible collection is the collection of the closed purchase agreement. The coverage start date is the closing date.

**Period end dates.** The coverage record carries an end date for the workmanship, systems, structural and roof leak periods of the program. Each period end date is the coverage start date plus the period's months, less one day: the same day of the month in the ending month, minus one. When that day does not exist in the ending month, the period ends on the last day of that month. Item periods counted in days end on the coverage start date plus the days.

The months used for each program are that program's own workmanship, systems, structural and roof leak months, in every one of the six programs from HomeCare 1-2-10 Standard to HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve.

## Worked dates (hypothetical closings)

| Closing date (coverage start date) | Period length | Same day in the ending month | Period end date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2024 | 12 months | 15 March 2025 exists | 14 March 2025 |
| 15 March 2024 | 24 months | 15 March 2026 exists | 14 March 2026 |
| 29 February 2024 | 12 months | 29 February 2025 does not exist | 28 February 2025 |
| 15 March 2024 | 30 days (a period counted in days) | not applicable | 14 April 2024 |

**Reading the third row.** The ending month, February 2025, has no 29th day, so the period ends on the last day of that month rather than on the day before a day that does not exist.

**Basis Q&A.**
- *Which date starts every period?* The coverage start date, which is the closing date.
- *Which program does a closed home receive?* The program whose eligible collection matches the collection on the closed purchase agreement.
